blurb: Shore Thing Fishing Charters offers fishing trips with licensed captains and boats in Louisiana and Mississippi. They provide a variety of fishing experiences including offshore and bay fishing, as well as bird watching tours. The Cat Island Experience allows guests to fish from sun up to sun down with guided trips, wade fishing, and kayaks.
extraNote: If booked on desired day, guests can be put on standby list · Docks located in Bay St. Louis and Pass Christian, MS · Year round
